summary: Added a pure custom target-date validator and routed validated dates through the same frozen turn request, stream, validation, and atomic commit path used by presets.
tests: Invalid and non-canonical ISO dates are rejected
Current and past dates are rejected
The 366-day maximum boundary is accepted and day 367 is rejected
Leap-day input remains canonical and locale-independent
The custom date reaches the frozen request and committed simulation clock unchanged
knownLimitations: Resolved in 13-22: the game action overlay now exposes a validated date input connected to the same frozen request path.
